sloka: एते चान्ये च बहवो राक्षसाः कामरूपिणः ।दिष्ट्या त्वया हता वीरा रघूणां कुलवर्द्धन ।। ७.१.३२ ॥
transliteration: ete cānye ca bahavo rākṣasāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ ।diṣṭyā tvayā hatā vīrā raghūṇāṁ kulavarddhana ।। 7.1.32 ॥

translations.english: Fortunately, O enhancer of the Raghu lineage, these and many other valiant form-changing demons have been slain by you.
